headline: Eurozone Inflation Rises to Three-Year High of 4% in October
summary: Eurozone annual inflation climbed to a three-year high of 4.0 percent in October, driven by a surge in energy costs linked to the Middle East conflict.
why: Inflation metrics are critical for central bank policymaking, directly influencing interest rate expectations and currency valuations across the currency bloc.

impacts.name: Euro
impacts.why: Higher inflation prints alter expectations for European Central Bank monetary policy.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: A jump in inflation to a three-year high driven by energy costs increases pressure on monetary authorities.
